title: cmd.result (server → platform, reliable (critical))
description: The answer to match.assign / match.update / match.unassign / cmd; envelope `ref` = that message's id, `epoch` = its epoch. Error codes: invalid_config, invalid_update, busy, stale_epoch, not_assigned, conflict, bad_phase, bad_args, bad_request, already_paused, not_paused, no_backup, checksum, not_connected, gotv_off, forbidden, invalid_command, unknown_command, unsupported, engine, io, offline.

rev.description: config_rev after match.update (or the server's on conflict)
